blurb: Aviara Golf Club offers a championship golf experience on a par 72, 7,007-yard Arnold Palmer designed coastal course with lush landscaping and water features. Members and guests can enjoy unlimited golf, premier practice facilities, racquet sports, wellness classes, and dining at the resort. The club also provides private lessons, group clinics, and a TaylorMade Performance Center for club fitting.
extraNote: 60-day advance booking window for members · No cart fees for Club at Aviara members · Discounts on lessons and club fittings for members · Pool access limited June 15 – September 15 for some memberships · Park Hyatt Aviara Resort, Carlsbad, CA
